package.name: go2_real_bringup
package.description:
Top-level bringup for the A*+MPC navigation stack on the real Unitree Go2, using the Go2 built-in Sport-mode controller (no CHAMP).
Orchestrates: - go2_bringup/go2_hw_bridge : SportModeState -> odom/TF, /cmd_vel -> Sport API - go2_real_lidar : /utlidar/cloud -> /lidar/points_filtered - go2_real_planner : A* + MPC + setpoint -> /cmd_vel (default or BO-tuned) - go2_real_goal_manager : RViz /goal_pose relay + waypoint mission runner - robot_safety (optional) : velocity limiter / safety gate - rviz2 (optional)
